title: Choose Continuum's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Bahi-Khata ledger; the dealt Boarding-pass & gate-board challenger beat it on both axes. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bahi-Khata
options.lineage: the red-cloth bahi-khata account book every Indian family and shop keeps
options.thesis: Your health kept like a family ledger: every entry sourced, every account reconciled.
materials: double rule closing a reconciled entry
options.viewport: Red cloth rail left; dashboard of Blind Spots set as reconciliations: two doctors' entries side by side, the unreconciled line between them, closed with a double rule when acknowledged.
options.risk: Ledger reads as accounting before medicine; clinicians may not feel it is a clinical tool.

raised.raise: Consent state carried by line form, not only hue: solid active, dashed pending, struck revoked.
One ink reserved exclusively for cross-doctor connections; nothing else may use it.
Each record section owns one fixed hue used on its tab and its rows everywhere.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: airline/railway boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: Your care as a live board that re-ranks itself, and an emergency card you carry like a boarding pass.
options.viewport: Light shell with a charcoal 'board' of Blind Spots and medicines ranked by urgency; a changed row re-ranks in place and stays lit amber until acknowledged; the emergency pass docks right.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: alerts map to board rows, the emergency card is literally a pass; patients and doctors both read it instantly.
options.risk: Travel metaphor can feel playful for illness if the board animates too much.

options.label: Reservation Chart
options.lineage: Indian Railways reservation charts and route maps
options.thesis: Care as a journey across stations: every doctor and lab a stop, Blind Spots the stops that never saw each other.
options.viewport: Navy shell; a horizontal care route Chennai → Bengaluru with each provider a station; Blind Spot cards hang from the two stations they connect.
options.risk: Familiar: transit-map metaphors are where many data products land.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white, one accent, every claim next to its proof.
options.viewport: Clean dashboard; alerts as neutral cards with one teal accent; proof (source document) beside each.
options.case: Holds clarity, loses audience identification: it could be any SaaS.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Hairline spectral lines on charcoal; state as line form.
options.viewport: Everything hangs off one off-centre rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: older patients cannot read hairline state.
options.kept: State as line form (solid / dashed / struck) for consent grants.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Terrain beneath, your course in reserved purple above.
options.viewport: Care course over a terrain of records.
options.case: Fuses poorly: unfamiliar to Indian patients and doctors.
options.kept: One ink reserved for cross-doctor connections only.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Tabbed divider boards with acetate leaves.
options.case: Fuses poorly: manual metaphor adds no clinical meaning.
options.kept: One fixed hue per record section, used everywhere.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item fills the screen; snap to the next.
options.case: Fuses poorly: records need comparison, not one-at-a-time.
options.kept: Next item pre-loaded: instant navigation between records.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Health-record SaaS at full craft: white cards, teal-blue accent, clean sidebar.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, stat tiles, alert list, medicine table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
